title: TiltedPvp+
description: Vanilla+ with added features to enhance your Minecraft gameplay
body:
# **Included components**
Tired of having to download multiple packs to make your game look clean? Well my pack combines the basics + more all into one pack. 
- low fire
- no crystal particles 
- small totem
- revamped crystal look
- clear inventory 

## **Gameplay**
- boosts frames
- high quality 
- clean look
- contains the essentials for cpvp/pvp

**Multiple colors to suit your style coming soon!**

Current color: Royal Blue
